summary.label: staged prior candidate; exact SHA256 recorded, revision label not inferred

finding: Current and staged prior Lynx both bury a 100% FR_Paw-weighted sole by 7.7mm during stance. This is physical contact error, not unrelated fur or a floor offset. See adjacent authored keys to distinguish source target error from between-key skeletal interpolation sag.
proposedFix: If adjacent stance keys stay at y=0, increase/adaptively subdivide baked joint animation sampling until full-vertex midpoint stance soles stay within 1mm, then repeat source contact-velocity and hardware lifecycle checks. Do not compensate by shifting the mesh or floor or by widening the 25mm threshold. No animation source was changed by this review.
